source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Query every NVIDIA GPU serial number with `nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=serial`.
criteria_facts: All GPU serial numbers are correct.
missing_source_information: Authoritative expected board/GPU serial mapping and device-count/model scope.

original_test_intent.statement: Read the NVIDIA-reported serial for every GPU and compare it with the authoritative physical/FRU inventory.
must_preserve: All GPUs, serial property and exact identity comparison.
must_not_infer: That a repeated board serial is always an error on a multi-GPU board.
That missing expected values prevent collection of actual values.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly keeps the read-only query fully automatable and maps results to UUID/BDF before authoritative FRU comparison.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 suggests a duplicate serial is inherently suspicious but NVIDIA documents that board serial may be shared across multiple GPUs on one board; acceptance must use the platform's board-versus-GPU serial semantics.

related_records: The approved asset/FRU source, not neighboring nvidia-smi cases, defines serial cardinality.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Source serial query remains authoritative for actual collection; official command documentation refines stable identity and duplicate interpretation.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Collect all actual serials now with UUID/BDF identity. Final PASS waits for an authoritative board/GPU serial map that explicitly permits or rejects shared board serials.

conditions_present: Read-only command and NVIDIA driver tool; no special package or mutation.
missing: Expected count and board/GPU serial-to-UUID/BDF mapping.
provider: Asset/platform owner supplies label/FRU mapping and serial cardinality rule.
safe_read_only_work: Run the complete identity+serial query and preserve actuals even before expected values arrive.
prohibited_until_resolved: PASS, rewriting identifiers, driver/firmware changes or calling every repeated serial a defect.
closure_evidence: Authoritative mapping covers every detected UUID/BDF and expected physical slot/board.

revision_candidate.purpose: Collect the NVIDIA-reported serial for every installed GPU and verify the complete UUID/BDF-to-serial inventory against the approved physical label/FRU mapping and its board-versus-GPU serial rules.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The intended NVIDIA GPU server with a functioning supported driver and `nvidia-smi`; applicable to single- and multi-GPU boards only when the reference defines serial sharing/cardinality.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every physical GPU returned by the driver, bound to stable UUID and PCI BDF rather than enumeration index; one read-only snapshot within the five-minute test activity.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Host identity and expected GPU count/model/slot map; authoritative physical label/FRU board/GPU serial mapping; rule for shared board serials; supported driver and approved read-only channel.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=uuid,pci.bus_id,name,serial --format=csv,noheader` once, retain raw output/status and verify row count, nonblank/support status, stable UUID/BDF attribution and exact normalized serial against the approved mapping. Collection may proceed without expected values, but comparison/PASS may not.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct host, NVIDIA driver and `nvidia-smi` operational; no GPU reset/update required; expected reference identified for final comparison.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Host and driver identity; exact command/status/time; complete raw CSV; expected and detected GPU counts; per-row model/UUID/BDF/serial; physical/FRU reference provenance; board/GPU sharing rule; missing/unexpected/mismatch analysis.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved asset/FRU map for the exact installed topology. Pass requires complete device coverage and exact expected serial association; a shared serial is acceptable only where the reference defines a shared board serial.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use index alone, embed credentials, bypass host identity, mutate persistence/power/driver/firmware, rewrite serials, discard N/A/blank values or reject duplicates without board semantics.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: None for the local read-only query; asset/platform owner provides reference and judges unresolved labeling semantics.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Collection and comparison are automatable; reading inaccessible physical labels and adjudicating asset-record errors are manual.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery for a read-only query. Preserve driver/query errors and refer them to a separate investigation without resetting or updating the GPU.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong host; unauthorized channel; driver/GPU lost; incomplete/truncated output; no stable UUID/BDF attribution. Missing expected reference stops only final PASS, not actual collection.

identified_defects: Source serial-only rows can be misattributed by order.
reason_for_change: Preserve simple read-only automation while preventing false duplicate failures and index-based device mismatches.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation
new_technical_evidence.applicability: nvidia-smi selective queries and device identity
new_technical_evidence.supports: UUID or PCI bus ID is recommended because index order is not stable, and board serial may be shared by multiple GPUs on one board.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target platform's physical label and board-sharing design remain owner data.

removed_ambiguities: Maps serials to UUID/BDF in one snapshot.
Defines when duplicate board serial can be valid.
Separates actual collection from final comparison.
resolved_blockers: Expected values are not required to collect actual serial evidence.
remaining_blockers: Authoritative mapping is required for PASS.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 removes a false duplicate-failure path by applying board-versus-GPU serial semantics and captures serial, UUID and BDF atomically instead of depending on enumeration order.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Read-only localized improvement; no execution-contract scope change requiring isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 290 queries serial for all GPUs in five minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 uses UUID/BDF; V3 corrects shared board-serial interpretation and atomic identity collection.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Read-only actuals may be collected before the expected FRU map; PASS may not.
